findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

A can was observed with a dent in the bottom seam. The PIC was shown and the situation discussed. Ensure that all cans are removed if there is a dent observed in any of the three seams (top, bottom or side) to protect consumers from possible botulism infections. The can was moved to discard to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

The test strips in the facility for the quaternary ammonia sanitizer are observed to be discolored during this inspection. They were tested in a solution by the inspector alongside their own test strips and did not produce the color change needed. Heat and moisture damage were discussed as possible damage vectors with the PIC. A follow up is being set for 10 days to ensure new strips are acquired.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A).

A mostly empty gallon of milk has a manufacturers use by date of 1/29/25 and a facility date mark of 1-20. Today is day 10 since opening and one day over the manufacturers date. The PIC was shown and discarded the container during this inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that all TCS foods are discarded within seven days of opening and prior to the manufacturers use by date.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

The wall above the three part sink has paint cracked and peeling away from the wall. Some small sections have broken off completely. The PIC is instructed to repair the paint prior to the next routine inspection.
